en.title: National Aeronautics and Space Administration: 29 references to former U.S. Code sections or former act names
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, 29 references in 23 sections use a former address or name: 17 cite a repealed section; 11 cite a section replaced by a new one when the title was enacted as positive law; 1 cites a section transferred to another section. Each reference was compared with release point 119-134 of the U.S. Code, which names where the old number went.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references finds a note that the section moved, or no section, instead of the text. A reference to a moved section may keep its legal effect, but the address no longer leads to the text. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides how to update each reference. Where the U.S. Code names the section the old number moved to, the evidence below gives it.
